notes: Real population by wilayat from Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information — 2023 estimates (updated from the 2020 e-census) for the 5 wilayats that make up this map's urban corridor (Muscat, Muttrah, Bawshar, Al Amarat, As Seeb; Qurayyat, a separate town 83km southeast and geographically cut off by mountains, is excluded from the map entirely). No real employment data exists: jobs are a flat 40% of resident population, redistributed across OSM buildings weighted by floor area only. Commute flows are an unconstrained gravity model — no real O/D data anchors it. The airport special point's demand uses an unsourced 40%-transfer estimate (Oman Air has publicly stated it is reducing connecting-traffic reliance from ~85% toward "under 50%" without a precise current published figure), disclosed as an estimate, not official data.
sources: https://www.ncsi.gov.om/publications (Oman NCSI, Statistical Yearbook — population by wilayat)
